source: General Directorate of Agriculture (GDA), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Cambodia — Sweet Corn Production Handbook (ផលិតកម្មដំណំពោតផ្អែម), in partnership with SNV
text:
Weeding, hilling (mounding soil at the base of plants), and irrigation are essential tasks for corn cultivation to ensure high yield, by reducing damage from pests and disease. Recommended practice:

- When plowing/harrowing, expose weeds to sun to kill them.
- Remove weeds regularly.
- Loosen soil and do the first weeding round when the plant is 15 days old after planting.
- Do the second weeding and hilling (mounding soil around the base) 30 days after planting.
- Do a third weeding round if necessary, when the plant is 50-60 days old.
- Irrigate whenever the soil surface appears dry.
